يحتجزا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِزَا (yaḥtajizā) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.zaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# يُحْتَجَزَا (yuḥtajazā) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒa.zaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
